window.overlap: Older unresolved candidates, family holds and watchlist entries were deliberately revisited.

method: Representative executed query strings are recorded below; broad queries were followed by primary paper, repository, archive and model-hub reads. Search ranking/date filters were imperfect. This is a bounded ten-modality sweep, not a systematic review or claim of exhaustive new-release coverage.
identity_normalization: Before discovery, current names and aliases across 390 displayed and 39 held records were normalized to case-insensitive alphanumeric identities; baseline is preserved in normalized_identity_baseline.json. Stable IDs reserved across both stores; family splits use distinct member names with old combined aliases retained only on the stable-ID successor.
